extracted.intended_audience: students and instructors in public relations, and practicing PR writers learning strategies and structures for PR writing
extracted.subtask_description: A textbook-oriented framework for teaching and learning public relations writing: strategic approaches, fundamental principles, preparation steps, audience-tailoring, crisis/turbulence writing, and social media writing. Intended to equip students with techniques and methods to write with understanding and purpose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic focus
rubrics_metrics.description: The Eleventh Edition takes a more strategic focus as it guides students through a logical progression of PR writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes strategy over ad-hoc tactics; organizes instruction so writers consider roles, principles, preparation, audiences, and turbulent contexts as part of a strategic whole.

rubrics_metrics.name: Roles and responsibilities of the PR writer
rubrics_metrics.description: Beginning instruction 'starting with the roles and responsibilities of the PR writer'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarify what is expected of a PR writer (ethical/organizational/functional responsibilities) before moving into craft; situates writing tasks within job roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing principles
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage of core 'writing principles' that underlie effective PR text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Introduces different styles and techniques behind writing principles — i.e., not only rules but the stylistic reasoning that supports them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparing to write
rubrics_metrics.description: Instruction on 'preparing to write' as a discrete stage in the PR writing process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers pre-writing activities (research, audience analysis, message strategy, planning) that set up successful drafts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing for select audiences
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on 'writing for select audiences' — tailoring messages to specific groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes audience analysis and adaptation of tone, content, channels, and framing to fit distinct stakeholder groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing for turbulent times
rubrics_metrics.description: A focus on 'writing for turbulent times' (e.g., crises, fast-changing contexts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses special considerations when messaging during crises or rapid change — clarity, speed, sensitivity, and strategic alignment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social media writing
rubrics_metrics.description: An entire chapter devoted to 'writing for social media'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treats social media as a distinct medium with its own conventions, formats, and audience expectations; includes platform-specific techniques.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write with understanding and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: Aim to 'write with understanding and purpose' — producing messages that are intentional and informed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on purposeful communication: every piece should have clear objectives, informed by audience and organizational goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Essential techniques and methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Equips students with 'essential techniques and methods needed to write with understanding and purpose.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical, trade-book approach combining theory and application—teaches methods (formats, templates, approaches) that practitioners use.
